instruction: Look at task-019_initial.scad. Change the model into a three-level step calibration block. Level 1 is 40 x 20 x 5 mm. Level 2 is 30 x 20 x 5 mm and centered on level 1. Level 3 is 20 x 20 x 5 mm and centered on level 2. The block height before text must be 15 mm. Add raised text labels on the exposed top surfaces: "5" on the level-1 ledge, "10" on the level-2 ledge, and "15" on the top level, using text() with about 0.8 mm raised extrusion. Add one shallow front-side reference line groove on each level, each 14 mm long, about 1 mm wide, and centered on the front face at z=2.5, z=7.5, and z=12.5 respectively. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-019_output.stl.
